<!-- pr-reviewer: 8f649c55326de6c1eb150046a98981c1b5e49423 -->
**Verdict: Not built - needs a maintainer look.** No blockers found in the read-through.

**Why it was not built:** the PR touches `Cargo.toml`, `crates/ui/Cargo.toml` and `Cargo.lock` (a new workspace dependency, `objc2 0.5`, macOS-only). Per the review rules a dependency change is not built or tested here until a maintainer has looked at it. Files to look at first: `Cargo.toml:51-54`, `crates/ui/Cargo.toml:30-32`, `Cargo.lock` (+1 line).

**What looks good**
- Trial merge with current main is clean (no conflicts).
- The lock diff is a single added edge, `objc2 0.5.3`, a version already in the lockfile (winit's); no new crate enters it. The dependency is MIT and macOS-gated.
- `os_quit.rs`: no `unwrap/expect/panic`; `AnyClass::get` instead of `class!`; each missing class, app or delegate is logged and returns false; the hook only sets an atomic flag, so nothing unwinds across FFI; `class_addMethod` never replaces an existing handler.
- The quit path reuses the guarded `actions::quit`, so the existing undo/dirty-prompt law is kept. Layering is fine (UI-only, no components).
- Provenance line present; file is about 107 lines; decision file `docs/decisions/144-macos-cmd-q.md` present; body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #144`; no `CHANGELOG.md` edit.
- Pinning test `os_quit_request_over_unsaved_changes_prompts_once` covers route-once, no exit, prompt shown, Don't Save quits.

**Local results:** not built (see above). Nothing was run.

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes for the maintainer (not blocking)**
1. Decide whether the new `objc2` workspace dependency is acceptable. If yes, the label can move to merge-ready (or ask for a full build/test review first).
2. The `unsafe` block in `os_quit.rs` (about lines 67-92) uses a `transmute` of the extern fn to `Imp` plus a `Q@:@` type string; it is documented with SAFETY comments but is worth a second pair of eyes. Real behaviour is only verifiable on a Mac (author reports a manual Cmd+Q pass).
3. Side effect already disclosed by the author: cancelling `terminate:` also cancels a logout/shutdown while CamCraft is open.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 8f649c55326de6c1eb150046a98981c1b5e49423 -->
**Verdict: Not built - needs a maintainer look.** No blockers found by reading. I did not build because the PR adds a dependency.

**Why it was not built:** `Cargo.toml` (workspace, line 51-54) and `crates/ui/Cargo.toml` (line 30-32) add `objc2 = "0.5"` as a macOS-only dependency. Per review rules a dependency change is not built here until a maintainer has looked at it. `Cargo.lock` only gains the edge `objc2 0.5.3` under camcraft-ui. That crate version is already in the lock (winit pulls it), so no new crate enters. Trial merge with current main is clean (no conflicts).

**What looks good**
- The cfg gating fix from #334 holds. `os_quit::request()` is `#[cfg(any(target_os = "macos", test))]` (os_quit.rs:23). On Windows/Linux non-test builds nothing references it: `route_pending` only reads `QUIT_REQUESTED`, `install()` is the `cfg(not(macos))` stub returning false, and the shell discards its result with `let _ =`. So there is no dead-code warning under `-D warnings`. The test uses `request()` under `cfg(test)` on every OS, which is covered.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!`. A missing AppKit, app or delegate is logged and returns false (os_quit.rs:55-77). `AnyClass::get` is used instead of the panicking `class!`.
- The FFI hook only stores an atomic and returns `NSTerminateCancel`, so nothing can unwind across the boundary. `class_addMethod` never replaces an existing method. SAFETY comments are present and the signature matches the type string.
- Routing goes through `actions::quit`, the same guarded Quit as the window X, so the unsaved prompt (#107) applies. Layering is fine (ui only).
- Provenance line, decision file `docs/decisions/144-macos-cmd-q.md`, `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #144` are all present. No `CHANGELOG.md` edit. Clean-room: Apple public docs only.
- The pinning test `os_quit_request_over_unsaved_changes_prompts_once` is portable (it exercises the flag and prompt, not AppKit).

**Local results:** not run (see above). Build, tests and clippy for camcraft-ui are not verified by this review. The PR body reports clippy clean and a hands-on macOS check from #334.

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs` is 1629 lines, far over the ~400-line guide; this PR adds 16 more. Worth a split at some point.
2. Cancelling `terminate:` also cancels a logout/shutdown while CamCraft is open (documented in the PR). Acceptable, but a maintainer may want to confirm.
3. The PR is not a draft, but this review does not change that since there are no blockers.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer-build: 8f649c55326de6c1eb150046a98981c1b5e49423 -->
**Follow-up build check: Ready for the maintainer to merge**

The maintainer has approved the macOS-only `objc2 = "0.5"` dependency, so I built this time. Trial-merged with current `origin/main` (clean, no conflicts) on Windows.

- `cargo tree -p camcraft-ui -i objc2@0.5.3 --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc` prints "nothing to print", so objc2 is not compiled for camcraft-ui on Windows. Against `aarch64-apple-darwin` it resolves to objc2 0.5.3, the copy winit already pulls (via objc2-app-kit), so the lock gains no new crate.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- unsaved os_quit`: 6 passed, 0 failed (includes `os_quit_request_over_unsaved_changes_prompts_once` and the close/save prompt tests).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean. The `#[cfg(any(target_os = "macos", test))]` gate on `os_quit::request()` raises no dead-code warning.
- The Linux `cargo check` was skipped because that target is not installed here.
- The macOS path itself (the real Cmd+Q prompt) can't be exercised on this machine. The author hand-tested it on macOS in #334.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
